package repo

import "errors"

// Store is a keyed store of integers.
type Store struct {
	m map[string]int
}

// Get returns the thing named n.
// It returns an error if n is unknown.
func (s *Store) Get(n string) (int, error) {
	v, ok := s.m[n]
	if !ok {
		return 0, ErrGone
	}
	return v, nil
}

// get reads without taking the lock and is not part of the API.
func (s *Store) get(n string) int { return s.m[n] }

func undocumented() int { return 0 }

// Errors this package returns.
var (
	// ErrGone is returned when the entry was evicted.
	ErrGone = errors.New("gone")
	// errHidden is not part of the API.
	errHidden = errors.New("hidden")
)
